name: claudetto
description: The claudetto plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: claudetto
plugins.description: Trims Claude Code 2.1.329 to what beats vanilla: disables the bundled builtin plugins at load, hands over context at task boundaries, and keeps prompt caching warm.

plugins.name: claudetto-spec
plugins.description: Spec-first loop for new behaviour: requirement IDs that tests cite, failing tests staged before implementation, and a spec_check tool that reports coverage.

plugins.name: claudetto-you-should-know
plugins.description: A side agent follows long sessions and shows a short plain-language note above the prompt when you are likely to miss something that matters.
